title: Chapter 454: The Fall Of The Sword God
content:
Chapter 454: The Fall Of The Sword God

Among the three strongest kings on the Sword God's side, only the Demon Emperor on Wang Shuo's side has the strength of the strongest king, but the advantage is that there are a large number of high-level generals, especially Gong Zheng and the others, who have already had strong cooperation. It can barely support it.

But it is obvious that it is only a matter of time before the Sword God wins.

Wang Shuo felt a little anxious.

In fact, Wang Shuo also has a trump card, which is to use a large number of thunderbolts to kill the enemy together.

Wang Shuo also has an absolute defense skill that can make him immune to damage.

Therefore, Wang Shuo activated absolute defense without hesitation, then rushed to the sword god, seized the opportunity, and hugged him tightly.

100 thunderbolts exploded around Wang Shuo and the Sword God.

When the sword god saw Wang Shuo rushing towards him, he became wary.

He also knew that this kid must be holding back some big move.

But he didn't expect that he actually wanted to die with himself.

The sword god wanted to break free, but was held tightly by Wang Shuo.

"Bang, bang..."

The huge air wave directly blew away the Demon Emperor and Ice Phoenix Emperor.

The surrounding senior warriors, including the two helpers invited by the Sword God, also flew out.

Wang Shuo even flew directly into the air and disappeared from everyone's sight.

As for the Sword God, his body was completely blown away on the spot.

The two strongest kings saw that the situation was not right and immediately retreated.

Faced with this situation, Gong Zheng, Zhao Bonde and others were at a loss for a while.

But the Ice Phoenix Emperor and the Demon Emperor felt that Wang Shuo was not dead and were quite honest at the moment.

If Wang Shuo dies, the Demon King will rebel immediately.

After a long while, Wang Shuo fell from the sky and landed on the ground.

Only at this moment did the Demon King feel how terrifying Wang Shuo was.

Shura, a terrifying existence.

Seeing that Wang Shuo was fine, Zhao Bond began to search for the remains of the Sword God among the ruins, hoping to find some clues.

After a while, he could only sigh dejectedly.

"Old Zhao, what's wrong? We defeated the Sword God, so we should be happy! Why are you still sighing?"

Zhao Bond was a little depressed and said with some disappointment: "Just now, I seemed to hear the Sword God mention the name Caiyi."

When Wang Shuo heard this, he felt thoughtful.

He immediately found the Ice Phoenix Emperor and asked, "Is the woman in the ice coffin named Ban Caiyi?"

Ice Phoenix Emperor nodded and said, "I really want to hear the Sword God mention that that woman is indeed named Ban Caiyi."

Zhao Bangde had a look of joy on his face and hurriedly asked: "Where is it?"

"Warcraft Mountains."

Zhao Bangde was in tears. He couldn't believe that there was really news about Ban Caiyi.

Seeing Zhao Bond's eager mood.

Wang Shuo directly took out the teleportation token from the Warcraft Mountains.

He directly asked Ice Phoenix Emperor, Gong Zheng and other five people to accompany Lao Zhao into the Warcraft Mountains to find Ban Caiyi.

Wang Shuo continued to handle government affairs.

Wang Shuo has now guessed that the master beggar should be the second prince.

During this period, Wang Shuo knew a little bit about what was happening in the entire Shenwu Empire.

Wang Shuo found the beggar and invited him into the lord's house.

"Second Prince, there's no need to pretend to be crazy or stupid now!"

"Haha..., I want to eat steamed buns." The second prince looked stupid.

Wang Shuo frowned.

Are you really stupid?

How could a high-level warrior go crazy?

Wang Shuo couldn't figure it out. Was his failure in the fight for the throne really such a big blow to him?

Wang Shuo tested him a few more times, and found that except for his fighting instinct, the second prince was no different from a fool in other aspects.
